user_reported_bug: I can't log in using the preview. Follow-up with screenshot showing a full-screen dark error page reading 'Something went wrong — An unexpected error occurred and our team has been notified.' with a 'Reload' button. User said: 'I'm logging in with the testpro. It fails after I click log in.'
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the focused auth/localStorage crash fix in preview: corrupt inflow_last_account values no longer show the Sentry ErrorBoundary, are cleared from localStorage, and testpro@test.com/password logs through to /dashboard. Clean login and valid saved-account chooser also reach /dashboard without the ErrorBoundary.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthPage.js now wraps JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('inflow_last_account')) in try/catch, removes the corrupt key on parse failure, and returns null; this matches the reported crash RCA.

Backend auth check was compared against /app/auth_testing.md and the auth playbook; this app uses a session_token httpOnly cookie. Direct curl POST /api/auth/login and subsequent /api/auth/me both returned 200 for testpro@test.com/password.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing test account testpro@test.com/password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused Playwright test injected inflow_last_account as '[object Object]', 'undefined', and truncated JSON '{"name":'. In all cases /auth did not show 'Something went wrong', localStorage was cleared, email login succeeded, and /dashboard rendered with data-testid=dashboard-main. Also verified clean localStorage login and valid saved-account chooser. Test harness used distinct X-Forwarded-For headers only to avoid preview IP rate limiting during repeated rapid logins; no APIs were mocked.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously AuthPage.js parsed localStorage['inflow_last_account'] during render with unguarded JSON.parse. Invalid stored strings threw synchronously, tripping the app-wide Sentry ErrorBoundary and keeping the user locked out on reload. The applied try/catch removal path prevents the render crash and recovers automatically.
